# Synthetic offline replay demonstration

This example was constructed by hand. No model was run; the successful execution status is illustrative and is not evidence of a live model trace. Replay with `python3 skills/arche-eval/scripts/repair.py score --run tests/fixtures/repair-translation-demo --output /tmp/translation-demo-score.json`. The embedded hashes detect changes to the example but are not signatures or proof of origin.
